purpose: Check whether the actual Antigravity subscription route enforces selection of one specified synthetic function

input.system_instruction: If proposing a skill choice, select the applicable synthetic skill
input.user_instruction: Give a direct text answer and do not call a function

observed.plain_text_evidence: In this adapter a successful turn without a function proposal emits AssistantFinal only for nonempty answer.Text; empty text produces a transport error. Exact answer text was not retained by this probe.

interpretation.claim: ANY plus an exact allowed function did not force a function call in this one native request. This route cannot currently be treated as enforcing that restriction.
interpretation.limitations: One adversarial synthetic compatibility request is not a comparison of model intelligence, a skill retrieval evaluation, or proof that every API/model route ignores ANY. No live AUTO comparison was performed.
interpretation.next_implementation_requirement: Butler must validate an explicit skill-selection decision before permitting task actions; a provider setting alone is insufficient. Selected skills must still load by exact digest through the current broker and authority checks.

retention.new_probe_accounting: Separate diagnostic: one known usage entry, 1978 tokens; not inserted into or used to qualify the closed ABC503 history
retention.earlier_preflight: First parent process stopped before key access or model admission because the host denied reading /proc/1/ns/pid. Retained separately on laba. The second parent checked /proc/self/ns/pid instead; native trial remained one-use.
retention.auth: Canonical encrypted private experimental PostgreSQL source; no auth export, stale clone or production service access
retention.cleanup: Probe container removed; zero remaining private database clients; private PostgreSQL stopped cleanly

offline_validation.location: laba; pinned Go image; network none; no auth mount
